assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
History of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Service provided is prolonged ambulatory monitoring via mobile cardiac telemetry
The service is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
The service is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent palpitations and dizziness in the context of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
